raw_knowledge_statement: \textsc{QLoRA} introduces multiple innovations designed to reduce memory use without sacrificing performance: (1) \textbf{4-bit NormalFloat}, an information theoretically optimal quantization data type for normally distributed data that yields better empirical results than 4-bit Integers and 4-bit Floats. (3) \textbf{Paged Optimizers}, using NVIDIA unified memory to avoid the gradient checkpointing memory spikes that occur when processing a mini-batch with a long sequence length.
